(api-gui-forms-bindingmanagerbase)=
## BindingManagerBase

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/binding/binding_manager_base/binding_manager_base.hpp>
class BindingManagerBase
```

BindingManagerBase is the renderer-neutral currency/edit/transfer contract shared by list, grid, property, and settings surfaces.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `virtual ~BindingManagerBase() = default` | Provides polymorphic destruction. |
| `virtual std::size_t count() const noexcept = 0` | Returns source row cardinality. |
| `virtual const BindingRecord* current() const noexcept = 0` | Returns the current row or null. |
| `virtual std::ptrdiff_t position() const noexcept = 0` | Returns current zero-based currency or -1. |
| `virtual bool binding_suspended() const noexcept = 0` | Reports whether automatic transfer publication is suspended. |
| `virtual bool set_position(std::ptrdiff_t position) = 0` | Moves currency if the requested position is admitted. |
| `virtual void cancel_current_edit() = 0` | Restores the current edit snapshot. |
| `virtual void end_current_edit() = 0` | Commits the current edit snapshot. |
| `virtual bool remove_at(std::size_t index) = 0` | Removes an admitted row. |
| `virtual void suspend_binding() = 0` | Defers automatic transfer publication. |
| `virtual void resume_binding() = 0` | Resumes and coalesces pending source publication. |
| `virtual bool pull_data() = 0` | Transfers every active binding from source to control. |
| `virtual bool push_data() = 0` | Transfers every active binding from control to source. |
| `virtual Event<BindingCompleteEvent&>& binding_complete() noexcept = 0` | Returns aggregate transfer completion observation. |
| `virtual Event<>& current_changed() noexcept = 0` | Returns currency-row change observation. |
| `virtual Event<>& current_item_changed() noexcept = 0` | Returns current-row content observation. |
| `virtual Event<std::ptrdiff_t>& position_changed() noexcept = 0` | Returns numeric currency change observation. |
| `virtual Event<const std::string&>& data_error() noexcept = 0` | Returns portable source validation error observation. |

(api-gui-forms-propertydescriptor)=
## PropertyDescriptor

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/binding/value/binding_value.hpp>
struct PropertyDescriptor final
```

PropertyDescriptor exposes renderer/language-neutral schema, serialization, mutability, invalidation, enum, standard-value, converter, and editor metadata without executable callbacks.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `PropertyDescriptor() = default` | Default construction supplies a writable text behavior descriptor; authored construction commits the core schema and invalidation contract. |
| `PropertyDescriptor(std::string authored_name, BindingValueKind value_kind, std::string authored_category, std::string authored_description, std::optional<BindingValue> authored_default, Dirty authored_effects, bool authored_subtree_effect = false)` | Default construction supplies a writable text behavior descriptor; authored construction commits the core schema and invalidation contract. |

**Data members**

```cpp
std::string name;
BindingValueKind kind{BindingValueKind::text};
std::string category{"Behavior"};
std::string description;
std::optional<BindingValue> default_value;
Dirty invalidation_effects{Dirty::none};
bool invalidates_subtree{};
bool readable{true};
bool writable{true};
bool browsable{true};
bool bindable{true};
bool resettable{};
bool change_notifications{};
// `kind` is the non-null payload kind. A nullable property may hold the ordinary BindingValue monostate without weakening that declared schema.
bool nullable{};
std::shared_ptr<const PropertyEnumDescriptor> enumeration;
// Static standard values are inert typed snapshots. Dynamic/contextual providers remain named services rather than executable descriptor data.
std::vector<BindingValue> standard_values;
bool standard_values_exclusive{};
std::string standard_values_provider_name;
// Stable, language-neutral service names. Descriptors remain inert: the executable converter/editor factories live in an inspection service registry owned by the consumer (for example PropertyGrid), never in the property snapshot itself.
std::string converter_name;
std::string editor_name;
```

## PropertyRegistration

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/binding/value/binding_value.hpp>
struct PropertyRegistration final
```

PropertyRegistration privately couples an inert descriptor to explicit getter, setter, change, reset, serialization, and origin callbacks registered by a retained Control.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `PropertyRegistration() = default` | Default construction is empty; authored construction moves the descriptor and callback set. |
| `PropertyRegistration(PropertyDescriptor authored_descriptor, Getter authored_get, Setter authored_set, ChangeConnector authored_change = {},` | Default construction is empty; authored construction moves the descriptor and callback set. |
| `: descriptor(std::move(authored_descriptor)), get(std::move(authored_get)), set(std::move(authored_set)), connect_changed(std::move(authored_change)), reset(std::move(authored_reset)), should_serialize(std::move(authored_should_serialize)), origin(std::move(authored_origin))` | Parser-visible declaration of the inert descriptor stored before executable callbacks. |

**Data members and type aliases**

```cpp
using Getter = std::function<BindingValue()>;
using Setter = std::function<void(const BindingValue&)>;
using ChangeConnector = std::function<SubscriptionToken(Component&, std::function<void()>)>;
using Resetter = std::function<void()>;
using ShouldSerialize = std::function<bool()>;
using OriginProvider = std::function<PropertyValueOrigin()>;
PropertyDescriptor descriptor;
Getter get;
Setter set;
ChangeConnector connect_changed;
Resetter reset;
ShouldSerialize should_serialize;
OriginProvider origin;
```
